_doc: Posting-slot windows and format-mix policy (Group CTO, 2026-09-12, founder-direct). Read by scripts/plan_day.py, which every daily-build prompt runs at Step 0. Edit this file, not the script, to move a window. Times are IST (+05:30). A window is a RANGE, never a fixed clock time: the planner picks a deterministic-but-varying minute inside it per day, so the account does not post at identical times every day (founder note 2026-09-12: fixed identical slots read as automated).

cadence._note: Founder ruling 2026-09-12: 3 posts a day, every day, no exceptions, until the account passes 50,000 followers. The COUNT is fixed; only the format mix inside the 3 flexes with performance data. A slot whose lane is closed or whose build fails is a BUILD-INCIDENT, not a silent drop to 2.

format_mix._note: Smoothed mean reach per format over the trailing window; a format scoring below demote_ratio x the top format's score loses its standing share. explore_every_n_days forces one slot back to the demoted format on a fixed cycle so a demotion can never become self-fulfilling (the format is never re-measured if it is never posted).

nuvarel.timezone_note: US/UK/UAE/Singapore/Australia + metro India. Morning-at-home and evening windows carry this niche; the late window catches US daytime.

anime_ekaya.timezone_note: India-weighted, younger audience; late-evening and night windows are where this niche is awake.

hype_tingles.timezone_note: Broad entertainment audience; commute and late-evening scroll windows.

hook_cta._doc: When a piece gets an explicit CTA and when it must not (founder correction 2026-09-12: a forced CTA on every post looks bad). The HOOK is always required; the CTA is conditional. Full rule and rationale: docs/cadence-and-format-policy.md section 4.
